name: Chart Grid
description: Renders up to eight charts into one grid file (SVG, PNG or self-contained HTML) and passes input port 0 through unchanged. Every entry of 'charts' selects its input port and uses the same settings as dap.chart; the grid owns the panel sizes, the column count and the shared title.

file.title: Output file
file.description: Absolute path of the .svg, .png or .html file to write; parent directories are created.

format.title: Format
format.description: svg is deterministic and golden-tested; png is drawn with Java2D; html embeds one inline SVG per chart and references no external resources.

title.title: Shared title
title.description: Title drawn once at the top of the grid; HTML uses it as <h1> and <title>.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Panels per row; rows follow from the number of charts.

width.title: Width
width.description: Total image width in pixels; each cell gets width/columns.

height.title: Height
height.description: Total image height in pixels; each cell gets the remaining height divided by rows.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: 1-8 chart panels. Each object takes the dap.chart settings (type, x, y, series, title, subtitle, labels, units, sort, log axes, data_labels, grid, annotations, facet, lat/lng/size/color/label) plus 'input' - the input port 0-7 to read.

input.title: Input port
input.description: Index of the connected input port this panel reads.
